content.title: Mountain-Road Orbit | Vehicle Route, Camera Handoff and Geographic Proof
content.summary: A graphite coupe is tracked through one mountain switchback to a wide route proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One vehicle identity and one route remain continuous. + Wheel motion agrees with camera and road direction. + Every camera handoff preserves a registered landmark. + The orbit reveals rather than changes geography. + The final wide frame proves the completed path.
quick_start.recommended_input: One original graphite electric coupe enters a wet cedar mountain road from frame left. Rise and arc thirty degrees ahead as the coupe remains centered and the next switchback appears. Pull high and wide until the coupe, completed switchback and cedar valley read in one frame.
required_anchors: One vehicle identity and one route remain continuous.
Wheel motion agrees with camera and road direction.
The orbit reveals rather than changes geography.
The final wide frame proves the completed path.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A graphite coupe is tracked through one mountain switchback to a wide route proof. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

creative_dna.mechanism: 实片主体为汽车而非候选标题中的单车。无人机以侧跟、前绕、后跟和高位拉远连续交接，同一深色车辆始终沿山路前进，终局用广角同时证明车辆、弯道与山体。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One vehicle identity and one route remain continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One vehicle identity and one route remain continuous."

invariants.rule: Wheel motion agrees with camera and road direction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Wheel motion agrees with camera and road direction."

invariants.rule: Every camera handoff preserves a registered landmark.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Every camera handoff preserves a registered landmark."

invariants.rule: The orbit reveals rather than changes geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The orbit reveals rather than changes geography."

invariants.rule: The final wide frame proves the completed path.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final wide frame proves the completed path."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
